title: Qlik Section Access Audit
dataSources: Qlik Sense logs (`qlik:scheduler`, `qlik:engine`, `qlik:proxy`), reload task history, section access audit, Qlik Cloud events (`com.qlik.v1.*`) and app/reload metrics via REST.
app: Qlik Sense Enterprise logs (Scheduler/Engine/Proxy/Repository) via Universal Forwarder; Qlik Cloud events via the Qlik Cloud REST API through HEC scripted inputs.
spl:
index=bi sourcetype=qlik:proxy (activity=access_denied OR activity=section_access_reduction)
| stats count as events by user, app_name, activity
| sort - events
description: Audits Qlik section-access (row-level security) events, surfacing denied access and data-reduction outcomes so governance can confirm users see only permitted data.
value: Misconfigured section access can leak restricted rows or lock out legitimate users; auditing it protects sensitive data and usability.
implementation: Ingest proxy logs; schedule daily; alert on unexpected denials or reductions. Review with data-governance owners.
visualization: Table of access events by user/app, timechart of denials.
grandmaExplanation: We check that Qlik shows each person only the data they are allowed to see and flag anything that looks wrong.
